_description: Short fixture: single-room powder-room + laundry refresh. Proves the deliberate ONE-PAGE architect layout and a compact client brief. De-identified fictional data. No clientPresentation block (tests the editorial fallback / no-palette path).

intentions.label: Refresh
intentions.text: Lift a tired powder room and laundry without major structural change.

intentions.label: Simplify
intentions.text: Practical storage and hard-wearing, easy-clean finishes.

intentions.label: Match
intentions.text: Sit comfortably with the recently renovated kitchen.

summaryParas: Priya wants a clean, hard-wearing refresh of the existing powder room and adjoining laundry: new finishes, better storage and improved lighting, keeping the current wall and plumbing positions wherever practical to control cost.
scopeIn: Strip and re-fit the powder room: new vanity, toilet suite, tiling and lighting.
Laundry refresh: new bench, cabinetry and tiled splashback; retain appliance positions.
scopeOut: Moving walls or relocating plumbing stacks — excluded to keep the scope fixed.

preferenceGroups.name: Finishes
items: Warm neutral tiles with a matte black tapware accent.
Timber-look laminate cabinetry to match the kitchen.

assumptions: Existing waterproofing to be assessed; re-do assumed in the powder room.
No changes to the switchboard are expected.

questions.action: Confirm whether the laundry splashback is tiled or a single laminate panel.
Confirm tapware finish (matte black vs brushed) against the kitchen.

nextStepsParas: With these two decisions confirmed, Blue Leaf prepares a fixed-scope quotation. As this is a small, defined refresh there is no separate pre-construction (PTSA) stage.

actions.action: Confirm powder-room waterproofing extent and set-down against the existing slab.
Confirm laundry cabinetry run and bench depth against the appliance positions.

purposeParas: A short internal brief for a fixed-scope powder-room and laundry refresh. Latest basis: Concept Sketch S-01. It separates the confirmed requirements from preferences still being developed.
confirmedReqs: Retain existing wall and plumbing positions wherever practical.
clientPrefs: Warm neutral tiles with matte black tapware.
Timber-look laminate cabinetry to match the kitchen.
coordination: Coordinate laundry cabinetry with the retained appliance positions.
outstanding: Splashback material (tile vs laminate) to be confirmed.
